actions.name: Increase wire feed pressure (adjust Feed Tensioner to correct pressure)
preconditions: Welder is powered off and the gun trigger is released before touching the Feed Tensioner (procedure ref p42 remedy 1; step 27 p17).
Wire spool is seated and the feed path is clear (procedure ref p17 step 27).

procedure_refs.quote: 1. Increase wire feed pressure properly. Follow step 27 on page 17.
If the wire stops instead of bending, the Feed Tensioner needs adjustment; slightly tighten the Feed Tensioner.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Keep hands clear of the feed mechanism while the welder is powered; the feeder moves without warning when the trigger is pulled.

actions.name: Fit the correct Feed Roller groove size
preconditions: Welder is powered off before opening the feed compartment (procedure ref p42 remedy 2; p12 feed roller).
The wire size on the spool is known, so the matching groove can be selected (procedure ref p12).

procedure_refs.quote: 2. Flip roll to correct size. Follow the Feed Roller instructions on page 12.
The groove on the Feed Roller must match the wire size marked on the spool.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Keep hands clear of the feed mechanism while the welder is powered.

actions.name: Replace the damaged MIG Gun, cable, or liner assembly
preconditions: Welder is powered off and disconnected before replacing the gun, cable, or liner (procedure ref p42 remedy 3).
Replacement gun, cable, or liner matches the OMNIPRO 220 (procedure ref p42 remedy 3).

procedure_refs.quote: 3. Replace damaged MIG Gun, cable, or liner assembly.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Disconnect power before handling the gun, cable, or liner — a damaged cable can expose live conductors.

actions.name: Loosen the Feed Tensioner to correct pressure
preconditions: Welder is powered off and the gun trigger is released before touching the Feed Tensioner (procedure ref p42 remedy 4; step 27 p17).
Wire spool is seated and the feed path is clear (procedure ref p17 step 27).

procedure_refs.quote: 4. Loosen Feed Tensioner so it applies only enough pressure to prevent continued spinning after the Gun Trigger is released.
If the wire stops instead of bending, the Feed Tensioner needs adjustment; slightly tighten the Feed Tensioner.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Keep hands clear of the feed mechanism while the welder is powered; the spool spins freely when the wingnut is loose.

actions.name: Straighten the bent gun cable
preconditions: Welder is powered off and the gun trigger is released before straightening the cable (procedure ref p42 remedy 1).
The cable path is clear of obstructions before the wire is fed again (procedure ref p42 remedy 1).

procedure_refs.quote: Straighten Gun cable.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
A severely bent cable can have damaged conductors inside; if the insulation is cut or the cable is kinked, replace it instead of straightening it.

actions.name: Untangle the wire spool
preconditions: Welder is powered off before the spool is handled (procedure ref p42 remedy 4).
The spool is seated and the feed path is clear before the wire is fed again (procedure ref p42 remedy 4).

procedure_refs.quote: Check wire for cross winding or tangled spool.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Keep hands clear of the spool and feed mechanism while the welder is powered; the spool spins freely when the wingnut is loose.

actions.name: Fit the correct Feed Roller groove size
preconditions: Welder is powered off before opening the feed compartment (procedure ref p42 remedy 5; p12 feed roller).
The wire size on the spool is known, so the matching groove can be selected (procedure ref p12).

procedure_refs.quote: Check Feed Rollers and ensure correct groove for wire diameter is being used.
The groove on the Feed Roller must match the wire size marked on the spool.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Keep hands clear of the feed mechanism while the welder is powered.

actions.name: Adjust the Feed Tensioner to correct pressure
preconditions: Welder is powered off and the gun trigger is released before touching the Feed Tensioner (procedure ref p42 remedy 6; step 27 p17).
Wire spool is seated and the feed path is clear (procedure ref p17 step 27).

procedure_refs.quote: Check Feed Tensioner and ensure it is set properly.
If the wire stops instead of bending, the Feed Tensioner needs adjustment; slightly tighten the Feed Tensioner.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Keep hands clear of the feed mechanism while the welder is powered; the feeder moves without warning when the trigger is pulled.

actions.name: Reduce wire feed pressure (adjust Feed Tensioner to correct pressure)
preconditions: Welder is powered off and the gun trigger is released before touching the Feed Tensioner (procedure ref p42 remedy 1; step 27 p17).
Wire spool is seated and the feed path is clear (procedure ref p17 step 27).

procedure_refs.quote: Adjust wire feed pressure properly. Follow step 27 on page 17.
If the wire stops instead of bending, the Feed Tensioner needs adjustment; slightly tighten the Feed Tensioner.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Keep hands clear of the feed mechanism while the welder is powered; the spool spins freely when the wingnut is loose.

actions.name: Replace the worn or wrong-size Contact Tip
preconditions: Welder is powered off before the tip is touched (procedure ref p42 remedy 2).
The replacement tip matches the wire diameter in use (procedure ref p42 remedy 2).

procedure_refs.quote: Replace with the proper tip or liner size for wire used.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Let the tip cool before touching it; the contact tip is hot after welding.

actions.name: Replace the damaged MIG Gun or repair its loose connection
preconditions: Welder is powered off and disconnected before the gun is handled (procedure ref p42 remedy 5).
A qualified technician does the inspection and replacement (procedure ref p42 remedy 5).

procedure_refs.quote: Have a qualified technician inspect and repair/replace as necessary.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Disconnect power before handling the gun, cable, or liner — a damaged cable can expose live conductors.

actions.name: Set the shielding-gas flow to the Settings Chart rate
preconditions: Welder is powered off before the gas flow is adjusted (procedure ref p42 remedy 7).
The Gun Cable Connector is fully inserted with no O-Rings exposed (procedure ref p42 remedy 7; p13 steps 13-14).

procedure_refs.quote: Ensure gas flow rate is set according to Settings Chart. Make sure MIG Gun Cable Connector is fully inserted into Wire Feed mechanism with no O-Rings exposed.
Gun Cable Connector fully inserted into the socket on the Wire Feed mechanism

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Check gas flow with the gun pointed away from yourself and others.

actions.name: Reseat the ground clamp connection
preconditions: Welder is powered off before the ground clamp is handled (procedure ref p42 remedy 8).
The workpiece surface near the clamp is clean bare metal (procedure ref p42 remedy 8).

procedure_refs.quote: Check the ground clamp connection to the workpiece and machine. Ensure the MIG Gun is properly secured.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Disconnect power before reseating the ground clamp.

actions.name: Restore the input supply voltage and amperage
preconditions: The welder's Power Switch is OFF while the supply is checked (procedure ref p43 remedy 2).
The outlet and breaker state are known before the supply is restored (procedure ref p43 remedy 2; p7 specifications).

procedure_refs.quote: Check the input voltage and amperage against the Specifications table on page 7.
Power Input 120/240 VAC

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Supply-side faults are remedied by a licensed electrician; this repair only checks the supply against the specifications.

actions.name: Reseat or replace the faulty Trigger
preconditions: Welder is powered off and disconnected before the Trigger is touched (procedure ref p43 remedy 3).
The gun connection is seated before the Trigger is tested (procedure ref p43 remedy 3).

procedure_refs.quote: Check that the gun connection is seated; a qualified technician checks, secures, or replaces the Trigger.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Disconnect power before replacing the Trigger.

actions.name: Connect the unit to the outlet properly
preconditions: The welder's Power Switch is OFF before the plug is handled (procedure ref p43 remedy 1).
The outlet and breaker state are known before the unit is reconnected (procedure ref p43 remedy 1).

procedure_refs.quote: Connect the unit to the outlet properly.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Do not force a plug into an outlet it does not fit; a damaged outlet is replaced, not worked around.

actions.name: Fit the correctly rated plug
preconditions: The welder's Power Switch is OFF before the plug is handled (procedure ref p43 remedy 3).
The plug rating is checked against the Specifications table on page 7 (procedure ref p43 remedy 3; p7 specifications).

procedure_refs.quote: Check the plug rating against the Specifications table on page 7.
Power Input 120/240 VAC

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Use only a plug rated for the OMNIPRO 220 supply (p7 specifications); an under-rated plug overheats.

actions.name: Secure the Input Power Cord twist-lock
preconditions: The welder's Power Switch is OFF before the cord is handled (procedure ref p43 remedy 5).
The outlet and breaker state are known before the unit is reconnected (procedure ref p43 remedy 5).

procedure_refs.quote: Ensure the twist-lock is fully secured.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Disconnect power before reseating the twist-lock; do not defeat the twist-lock.

actions.name: Replace or refill the shielding-gas bottle
preconditions: Welder is powered off before the bottle is changed (procedure ref p43 remedy 1).
The replacement bottle matches the OMNIPRO 220 shielding-gas fitting (procedure ref p43 remedy 1).

procedure_refs.quote: Replace or refill the shielding-gas bottle.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Keep the gas bottle secured upright and away from heat.

actions.name: Adjust the regulator to the correct gas flow
preconditions: Welder is powered off before the regulator is adjusted (procedure ref p43 remedy 2).
The bottle is not empty — an empty bottle is replaced first (procedure ref p43 remedy 1).

procedure_refs.quote: Adjust the regulator to the correct gas flow.

safety_requirements: Follow your plant's lockout procedure before anyone works on this machine. This is not a safety assessment.
Check gas flow with the gun pointed away from yourself and others.
